title: NSA operation ORCHESTRA Annual Status Report - FOSDEM 2014
summary: Poul-Henning Kamp's FOSDEM 2014 talk presents a fictitious NSA program called ORCHESTRA, satirizing how intelligence agencies could influence startups and open source. It is a humorous but pointed look at surveillance and subverted software.
why: Recommended as an entertaining talk showing that targeting software projects and introducing bugs is nothing new.

quote.text: It’s pretty entertaining and illustrates that this is nothing new.
